metadata.purpose: vox-explainer slate cut of Quantum Mechanics Vol. 4 candidate 02. Source chapter: books/quantum-mechanics-vol4/chapters/06-open-systems-and-lindblad.md (Bloch-sphere decoherence mechanism only — no Lindblad derivation, no T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tphi algebra, no jump-operator formalism).
metadata.clock: narration (ElevenLabs) — durations below are word-count estimates until GATE 0 audio lock

style_bible.visual_style: editorial flat on cream ground; geometric primitives; Montserrat chips; EB Garamond annotations; no gradients, glows, or shadows
style_bible.color_palette: cream ground, ink serif type, teal = the quantum state / pure / surface / coherent; crimson = the classical limit / mixed / center / decoherent

metadata.color_semantics: teal #1F6F5C = the quantum state / pure superposition / surface of the Bloch ball; crimson #BF3339 = the classical mixed state / center of the Bloch ball / fully decohered; never swap mid-film
metadata.note: Card exclusions honored: NO Lindblad-equation derivation, NO T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tphi algebra, NO jump-operator formalism. One mechanism only: the Bloch-sphere arrow spirals from surface inward to center as environment couples — the pure-to-mixed transition is the decoherence story.
